rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and correctly notes strong ICM/TE, but it overinterprets image details, introduces features not clearly verifiable from a single image, and creates confusion around the reported expansion grade versus image/lab description.

Integrates age, infertility diagnosis, oocyte yield, sperm parameters, BMI, prior cycle history, and especially thin endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis; AMH is unavailable and some inferences about male factor are speculative.

Overall structure is logical and the thin endometrium is appropriately highlighted, but there are inconsistencies in grading interpretation and some probability adjustments and mechanistic claims are not well supported.

Appropriate support for single embryo transfer and caution about thin lining, but several adjunct recommendations (aspirin, G-CSF, acupuncture, embryo glue, ERA after one failure) are not strongly guideline-supported for routine use.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer strategy, luteal support considerations, and future workup/planning, though some suggestions are more speculative than standard practice.
